summary.en: Statistics-only config with supported schema; columns reference standard stat IDs and match the description of display-only, no battle settings or player data. No issues found, though the submission is explicitly temporary and should be withdrawn as stated.
summary.zh: 仅统计配置，使用受支持的 schema；列引用了标准统计 ID，与“仅显示、无战斗设置或玩家数据”的描述一致。未发现问题，但该提交明确为临时性，应按说明撤回。

findings.en: Columns use minimal identifier-only entries (turns, finalProfit). No formatting, thresholds, or code present, so no unsafe JavaScript or external data access to review.
findings.zh: 列使用仅含标识符的极简条目（turns、finalProfit）。无格式化、阈值或代码，因此没有需要审查的不安全 JavaScript 或外部数据访问。

findings.en: Description states this is a temporary verification submission to be withdrawn; alignment between description and config is consistent, but maintainers may wish to discard it after testing.
findings.zh: 描述说明这是将被撤回的临时验证提交；描述与配置一致，但维护者可能希望在测试后将其丢弃。
